faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions About GME Remit
faq.subheading: Find answers to common questions about sending money with GME Remit

items.question: How long does it take to send money with GME Remit?
answer: GME Remit transfers are typically completed in around 10 seconds, although actual transfer time may vary depending on the receiving country, bank, or payout method.

items.question: Is GME Remit safe to use?
answer: Yes. GME Remit is a licensed remittance service in Korea and is supervised by the relevant Korean financial authorities. We use secure customer verification and transaction processes to help protect our customers and their transactions.

items.question: How do I sign up for a GME Remit account?
answer: Download the GME Remit app, create your account, and complete the required identity verification. Once your registration and verification are completed, you can start using GME Remit services.

items.question: Which countries can I send money to with GME Remit?
answer: GME Remit supports international money transfers to many countries worldwide. Available destinations and payout options can be checked directly in the GME Remit app.

items.question: What if I have a problem with my transfer?
answer: Our customer support team is available from 10:00 to 23:00, Monday to Sunday.
You can contact us by phone at {SUPPORT_PHONE_NUMBER} or through the GME Remit app.
You can also message us through our official GME Africa social media channels, including Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and ChannelTalk.
If you prefer in-person assistance, GME Remit also has branches across Korea where our staff can assist you directly.

cautions.title: Cautions

items: For overseas merchant payments, non-USD currencies are converted to USD based on Mastercard exchange rates, processed on the payment approval date (approved transactions) or the date GME receives billing information (unapproved transactions). The KRW billing amount, including a 1.25% overseas fee, is added to the KRW amount based on GME's USD exchange rate and deducted from GME Pay.
Billing Amount = (Payment Amount × Exchange Rate) + Overseas Fees (International Brand Fee² + Overseas Payment Fee²)
The exchange rate is GME's card payment USD rate, updated every 15 minutes, applied at the time of payment approval (or when GME receives billing information).
International Brand Fee² = (Payment Amount × Exchange Rate) × Mastercard Fee Rate (1.0%)
Overseas Payment Fee² = (Payment Amount × Exchange Rate) × GME Card Fee Rate (0.25%)
When paying in KRW at overseas merchants, an additional DCC fee (approx. 3-15%) may apply. Blocking overseas KRW payments and paying in local currency is more cost-effective.
You can set overseas KRW payment (DCC) restrictions in the GME app. Go to: Card > Card Management > 'Overseas KRW Payment Restriction' setting (Default: 'Restricted')
For more details, please contact Customer Center (1588-6864) or visit www.gmeremit.com.
